no_findings_rationale: C1 (§7 Rollback Plan): present and step-by-step — split into §7.1 pre-implementation doc-only (3 ordered steps) and §7.2 post-implementation state rollback (5-step abort-ordered sequence); not a single 'revert the deploy'. C3 (§8): change_level is C3, not Emergency; check is N/A and the lens passes. C4 (§3 Failure-mode delta + Async-capture failure analysis): four new runtime branches enumerated plus three CHG-altitude deltas; the async on-redirect capture is failure-analyzed for overflow (drop-and-count-loss, never re-couple/block the redirect) and the non-fatal contract (VisitCountRecord still increments, only rolling-window timestamp lost). C5 (§7.2 RTO/RPO): RPO=0 pre-migration; post-migration RPO=last snapshot, RTO=snapshot+drop duration, with the buffered-but-unflushed exclusion explicitly called out as an acceptable-loss class. Prior findings re-verified resolved: CE-1 (async failure analysis now present in §3), CE-2 (§7.2 step 2 stops the on-redirect writer and drains in-flight async writes so the table is quiescent before snapshot — both reader AND writer quiesced), CE-3 (buffered-but-unflushed exclusion now explicit in the RTO/RPO note). No new failure modes introduced at fixer-touched locations.
